paite: Pathian aw, vai hon hawmsak inla, Pathian limsak lou nam tung ah ka thu hon genpih in; aw, mikhem hat, midiklou lak ah hon humbit in.
heading: Saltangmi Thumna / (Sam 42)

paite: Nang ka hatna Pathian na hi ngal a; bang ding in ahia na hon pampaih ding? Bang ding in ahia melma nuaisiahna ziak a lungkham a ka mau vialvial nak?
Aw, na vak leh na thutak sawlkhia inla, amaute'n na mual siangthou ah hon pi in, na omnate hon tun uhen.
Pathian maitam kiang ah ka pai ding, Pathian ka nopna mahmah kiang ah; Pathian, ka Pathian aw, kaihging toh in ka hon phat ding hi.
Ka hinna aw, bang achia kun nilouh? Bang achia ka sung a buai? Pathian lamen in; amah phat ding ka hi ngal a, hon panpihpa leh ka Pathian.
